# KuDownloader

> KuDownloader is a free, open-source download manager for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, made by Kuduy (https://kuduy.com/). It downloads files over many connections at once, resumes after any interruption, saves videos and music from 1,000+ sites, handles torrents, and sends files between your own devices with KuAirSend. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

## Key facts

- Price: free. License: MIT (open source).
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 11 or later (Apple silicon and Intel), Linux (.deb, .rpm, Arch package; x86_64 and ARM64), Android 7 or later (APK).
- Browser extension: Firefox (listed on Firefox Add-ons), Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (installed from the desktop app).
- Not on Google Play: Google Play does not allow apps that download from video sites; the APK is published on GitHub.
- Privacy: downloads, history and settings stay on the user's devices; nothing is sent to the developer.
- Does not bypass DRM.

## Features

- Multi-connection downloads that tune themselves while running; resume after lost connections, restarts and expired links.
- Videos and music from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Vimeo and 1,000+ sites (quality choice, subtitles, playlists, audio-only as M4A, MP3, Opus or FLAC).
- Torrents and magnet links, with file selection.
- Queues, schedules (for example overnight), speed limits and profiles.
- Batch downloads, numbered patterns and "fetch every file on a page".
- Browser integration: downloads started in the browser open KuDownloader with the site's cookies.
- KuAirSend: send files, folders, text and links between phones and computers on the same network, encrypted, without the internet.
- Android: a private browser with an ad and tracker blocker and a download button on videos; Wi-Fi-only downloads.
- Themes: light and dark palettes, accent colours, twelve languages; signed automatic updates.
